newsitem.title: USA: Star says diamond test phase completed.
newsitem.headline: Star says diamond test phase completed.

text.p: Star Resources Corp said Monday that the Arkansas Department of Parks and Tourism completed Phase II of a testing program at the Crater of Diamonds State Park in Pike County.
The test program is aimed at evaluating the geology and grade of the diamond-bearing reserve at the state park, Star Resources said.

The results of the latest test do not indicate commercial potential at this time, Star said. Summary reports are now being completed to determine the potential for Phase III testing at the crater, it said.
Star said it now has control of a sampling plant near Murfreesboro, Ark., and is considering diamond testing on some of its latest leased properties near the state park.
Star said that through its wholly owned subsidiary, Continental Diamonds Inc, it is one of two participants granted the right to jointly conduct exploration of the state park by Arkansas regulators.
